name: Frame
description: Customizable Jellyfin browser client. Original Jellyfin Web stays available.

versions.changelog: Add native Jellyfin music libraries, song browsing and a persistent audio player with queue, shuffle and repeat. Improve subtitles, installed fonts, library naming, custom tags and layout controls. Harden playback, artwork-saving and connection transitions.

Enable automatic updates for Frame through Jellyfinâ€™s Update Plugins scheduled task. Restart Jellyfin after an update to load the new version. Internal Diagnostics builds remain excluded from automatic updates.

Improve playback controls, subtitles, custom fonts and reusable tags. Add compact ticket-style Watch and Resume buttons, smoother transitions and a clearer offline screen. Automatically fill missing display metadata and artwork through verified provider IDs while preserving existing edits. Expand artwork selection and filter images that exceed processing limits.
Fix relay HTTP 502 failures for valid HLS playlists larger than 1 MB. Retain bounded reads and existing authorization checks.
Source fingerprint and documentation maintenance. No intentional playback or UI changes.
